messages:
IncidentBot: Pager: high error rate detected on /v1/generate via api-gateway (elevated 5xx + increased 504 timeouts). Severity: P1. Escalated to on-call. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-gateway#timeouts :bell:
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. looking at dashboards now — 5xx spike started ~ 17:22 UTC, backend latency rising. tagging Raj and Lina. @Raj can you grab gateway logs?
Raj: on it. pulling gateway pods logs. early glance: lots of upstream timeout errors from model-proxy, and no consistent trace IDs in logs (sampling very low?).
Lina: checking traces — trace system shows many requests with missing span headers; traces that do exist are short and don't include model-proxy spans. sampling at 0.005 in prod config. this explains poor root-cause visibility.
Theo: customer impact: Maria says ACME-Enterprise reported timeouts for batch jobs, ~12% of requests failed in last 15m. CS notified customers. raising short status note.
Maria (CS): confirmed, customers seeing 504s for inference endpoint, ticket escalated. customers asking for ETA. please advise soon.
Maya (oncall): priority: mitigate customer impact, then restore observability. proposed quick mitigations: 1) add temporary header passthrough for X-Trace-ID/X-Span to gateway to force trace correlation; 2) enable temporary debug logging at gateway and model-proxy; 3) raise trace sampling to 1% for the next 30 minutes.
Raj: I can flip sampling and increase log level on model-proxy. but model-proxy logs are heavy — we'll stream to a short-lived index. preparing patch.
Lina: I can push a lightweight Envoy header insertion on the edge to ensure trace headers propagated. small change to filter chain.
Maya (oncall): going to apply stopgap instrumentation now. executing quick checklist:
- enable trace sampling = 0.01 -> 0.01 to 0.1? -> set to 0.01 -> actually set to 0.01 -> looks like existing was 0.005 so bump to 0.02 for 30m
- set gateway log level to debug for route /v1/generate
- inject X-Request-ID / X-Trace-Id passthrough
- create temporary log forwarder index and set retention 1h

Raj: applying model-proxy debug -> kubectl patch deployment model-proxy -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"model-proxy","env":[{"name":"LOG_LEVEL","value":"debug"},{"name":"TRACE_SAMPLING","value":"0.02"}]}}]}}}'

Lina: envoy filter (edge) patch snippet I'm about to apply:
```
filters:
  - name: envoy.filters.http.header_to_metadata
    typed_config:
      "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_to_metadata.v3.Config
      request_rules:
        - header: "x-trace-id"
          remove: false
          on_header_present:
            metadata_namespace: "trace"
            key: "x-trace-id"
```
Applying now to edge-gateway-1 (canary first)

Theo: quick note: prefer not to raise sampling too high due to cost — 2% for 30m is ok. Also throttle debug logs to only the failing route to avoid noise.

IncidentBot: Deployment started: envoy-filter canary -> edge-gateway-1. status: in-progress. (link: https://ci.internal/deploys/4578)
Maya (oncall): canary looks good, no CPU spike. rolling to remaining gateways.

Raj: model-proxy debug applied, logs show now consistent X-Trace-Id in upstream requests. model-proxy timing shows timeouts when connecting to the TPU cluster (connect timeouts ~200ms -> retries stacked). increasing backend pool and reducing per-connection timeout as workaround.

Lina: traces now showing model-proxy spans for ~8% of sampled requests — enough to correlate. early signal: upstream TPU control plane returning 429/504 under burst. opening ticket with infra team to investigate TPU cluster throttling.

Maya (oncall): mitigation steps next: 1) temporary increase of backend concurrency pool from 1000 -> 1500 for model-proxy; 2) reduce per-connection timeout from 1.2s -> 0.8s to fail fast and allow fallback routing; 3) enable automatic fallback to smaller model-variant for orgs flagged with high error rates.

Raj: applying concurrency bump via feature-flip and k8s config. command:
```
kubectl apply -f model-proxy-config-patch.yaml
# content: concurrency_pool: 1500, connect_timeout_ms: 800
```

Ops-Bot: Fflag: model-proxy.concurrency set to 1500 (applied). connect_timeout set to 800ms.

Maya (oncall): observing metrics — 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 4% in last 6 minutes. customer impact reduced but still elevated. continuing monitoring.

Maria (CS): passing update to ACME: "We applied temporary mitigations, reduced failure rate substantially. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for full fix." They appreciate the quick response.

Theo: important: create post-incident action item to restore sampling and remove debug logs after 60m. also add runbook step to ensure trace headers enforced by default.

Maya (oncall): creating incident doc and assign follow-ups: - infra to investigate TPU throttling (owner: Theo) - runtime team to add mandatory trace header propagation test (owner: Lina) - ops to add short-lived debug pipeline template (owner: Raj)

IncidentBot: Incident P1 acknowledged and under active mitigation. current status: partial mitigation, customer impact reduced. incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3765432100
Maya (oncall): handing to night oncall in 45m — will leave detailed notes in incident doc and a quick debrief in morning. :wave:
Maya (oncall): last check: 5xx ~2.8% and falling, traces restored for sampled requests, debug logs active. will revert debug and sampling after stabilization.
